test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: On the 46th Civil Accounts Day, as a part of ‘Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) and Digital India eco-system’, the Government of India introduced which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**E-bill processing system**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Government of India introduced the **E-bill processing system** on the 46th Civil Accounts Day.
 
• This initiative is part of the 'Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) and Digital India eco-system'.
 
• The E-bill processing system aims to enhance transparency, efficiency, and accountability
